output.title: Maximum out-of-pocket (MOOP) amount on a Medicare Advantage plan
output.draft_text:
Question: What is the MOOP on this Medicare Advantage plan?

Answer (may be said in your own words):
The maximum out-of-pocket amount, or MOOP, is the most you would pay in a plan year for [types of covered services that count toward the MOOP]. For your plan, [plan name], the in-network MOOP for [plan year] is [in-network MOOP amount]. [If applicable: The combined in-network and out-of-network MOOP is [combined MOOP amount].]

Costs that count toward the MOOP include [list of cost types that count, for example copays, coinsurance, deductibles]. Costs that do not count include [list of cost types that do not count, including premiums if applicable]. Prescription drug costs [do / do not] count toward this MOOP: [explanation of how Part D drug costs relate to the MOOP].

Once you reach the MOOP, [what the member pays for covered services for the rest of the plan year].

So far this plan year, you have [amount applied toward MOOP] applied toward your MOOP, based on the plan records I can see today. [Note on how current the accumulator information is, for example claims processing lag.]

You can also find your MOOP in your [document name, for example Evidence of Coverage or Summary of Benefits], [section or page reference], or by [other member self-service option].

Advocate notes:
- Look up the member's MOOP and year-to-date amount in [system or screen name].
- If you are a Pharmacy advocate and cannot view medical accumulators, [routing or warm transfer instructions, including queue or phone number].
- If the member asks whether a specific drug cost counts toward the MOOP, [approved response or routing].

author_checklist: Confirm whether the MOOP amount varies by plan or product and how advocates locate the correct amount for the member's specific plan.
Confirm the in-network MOOP and, for plans with out-of-network coverage, the combined MOOP for the current plan year.
Confirm which cost types count and do not count toward the MOOP.
Confirm how prescription drug (Part D) costs relate to the MOOP and approve the exact wording for Pharmacy advocates.
Confirm what the member pays after the MOOP is reached.
Confirm the system or screen where advocates can see the MOOP and year-to-date accumulator, and whether Pharmacy advocates have access.
Confirm the routing or transfer process when a Pharmacy advocate cannot answer MOOP questions.
Confirm whether a disclaimer about accumulator timing or accuracy is required, similar to the pricing estimate disclaimer (U-RX-EDU-001-09), and obtain Legal review if needed.
Confirm the member-facing document name and section where the MOOP is published.
Confirm whether this unit should be shared with the pharmacy knowledge base, since both Pharmacy and Insurance advocates asked this question.
